node.title: Nonconstant pencil planes control regular children through quadrics
node.statement: For polynomial V of dimension s, a nonconstant pencil T*(P,Q) has dimension at most s-1. At that maximum its component span is V and every regular anchor preserves maximality at the next shared dimension. In a regular5/4 pair/shared enclosure, any nonconstant pencil plane rules out whole-rank-one3/3 children. The carrier image lies on a smooth quadric or quadric cone: all nonvertex inner projections are birational, while an actual cone-vertex child retains the entire nonconstant plane. This holds in every characteristic, with full gcds and actual rather than generic anchors.
